تقتفوا (form VIII)
# تَقْتَفُوا (taqtafū) /taq.ta.fuː/: second-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِقْتَفَى (iqtafā)
# تُقْتَفَوْا (tuqtafaw) /tuq.ta.faw/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِقْتَفَى (iqtafā)
